"overall": "The psalm mostly sounds dignified and sayable. The three refrains (convertei-nos ... seremos salvos) are clean, and they carry the whole psalm. The vine section is the weak stretch: small calques ('à vista dela', 'Seja a vossa mão'), clitic snags ('e a vindimam', 'a pastou') and the number clash in v.17 make it sound translated rather than prayed.",
